verses.text: The Song of Songs, which is Solomon's.
verses.textZh: 所羅門的歌，是歌中的雅歌。（新娘）

verses.text: 'May he kiss me with the kisses of his mouth! For your love is better than wine.
verses.textZh: 願他用口與我親嘴；因你的愛情比酒更美。

verses.text: 'Your oils have a pleasing fragrance, Your name is [like] purified oil; Therefore the maidens love you.
verses.textZh: 你的膏油馨香；你的名如同倒出來的香膏，所以眾童女都愛你。

verses.text: 'Draw me after you [and] let us run [together]! The king has brought me into his chambers.' 'We will rejoice in you and be glad; We will extol your love more than wine. Rightly do they love you.'
verses.textZh: 願你吸引我，我們就快跑跟隨你。王帶我進了內室，我們必因你歡喜快樂。我們要稱讚你的愛情，勝似稱讚美酒。他們愛你是理所當然的。

verses.text: 'I am black but lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem, Like the tents of Kedar, Like the curtains of Solomon.
verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的眾女子啊，我雖然黑，卻是秀美，如同基達的帳棚，好像所羅門的幔子。

verses.text: 'Do not stare at me because I am swarthy, For the sun has burned me. My mother's sons were angry with me; They made me caretaker of the vineyards, [But] I have not taken care of my own vineyard.
verses.textZh: 不要因日頭把我曬黑了就輕看我。我同母的弟兄向我發怒，他們使我看守葡萄園；我自己的葡萄園卻沒有看守。

verses.text: 'Tell me, O you whom my soul loves, Where do you pasture [your flock], Where do you make [it] lie down at noon? For why should I be like one who veils herself Beside the flocks of your companions?'
verses.textZh: 我心所愛的啊，求你告訴我，你在何處牧羊？晌午在何處使羊歇臥？我何必在你同伴的羊群旁邊好像蒙著臉的人呢？（新郎）

verses.text: 'If you yourself do not know, Most beautiful among women, Go forth on the trail of the flock And pasture your young goats By the tents of the shepherds.
verses.textZh: 你這女子中極美麗的，你若不知道，只管跟隨羊群的腳蹤去，把你的山羊羔牧放在牧人帳棚的旁邊。

verses.text: 'To me, my darling, you are like My mare among the chariots of Pharaoh.
verses.textZh: 我的佳偶，我將你比法老車上套的駿馬。

verses.text: 'Your cheeks are lovely with ornaments, Your neck with strings of beads.'
verses.textZh: 你的兩腮因髮辮而秀美；你的頸項因珠串而華麗。

verses.text: 'We will make for you ornaments of gold With beads of silver.'
verses.textZh: 我們要為你編上金辮，鑲上銀釘。（新娘）

verses.text: 'While the king was at his table, My perfume gave forth its fragrance.
verses.textZh: 王正坐席的時候，我的哪噠香膏發出香味。

verses.text: 'My beloved is to me a pouch of myrrh Which lies all night between my breasts.
verses.textZh: 我以我的良人為一袋沒藥，常在我懷中。

verses.text: 'My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms In the vineyards of Engedi.'
verses.textZh: 我以我的良人為一棵鳳仙花，在隱基底葡萄園中。（新郎）

verses.text: 'How beautiful you are, my darling, How beautiful you are! Your eyes are [like] doves.'
verses.textZh: 我的佳偶，你甚美麗！你甚美麗！你的眼好像鴿子眼。（新娘）

verses.text: 'How handsome you are, my beloved, [And] so pleasant! Indeed, our couch is luxuriant!
verses.textZh: 我的良人哪，你甚美麗可愛！我們以青草為床榻，

verses.text: 'The beams of our houses are cedars, Our rafters, cypresses.
verses.textZh: 以香柏樹為房屋的棟梁，以松樹為椽子。
